title: The general lower-bound conjecture for uniform partition integrals
statement:
Let $\rho\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.2}\in\mathcal{P}(n)$ be a partition of $n$ elements with $r$ blocks of sizes

$$
n_{1}\leq n_{2}\leq \ldots\leq n_{r}.
$$

Let $K_{\rho,u}$ denote the quantity associated with the partition $\rho$ and the uniform density, and let $g^{(k)}(0)$ denote the $k$th derivative of $g$ evaluated at $0$. **General lower-bound conjecture.**

$$
K_{\rho,u}\geq \prod_{j=1}^{r-1}g^{(2n_{j})}(0).
$$

The conjecture is motivated by numerical simulations and examples and extends the established inequality for partitions with three blocks. The source gives no resolution of the general case.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1010.0624

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2010).
source_name: Gabriel H. Tucci and Philip A. Whiting, “Eigenvalue Results for Large Scale Random Vandermonde Matrices with Unit Complex Entries”, arXiv:1010.0624 (2010).
